turns.q: I want something for everyday use, good quality, and I care about value for money.
turns.replyTail:
For everyday use and good value for money, the best choice depends mainly on your body shape, sleeping position, and whether you sleep alone or with a partner. The right level of support matters more than simply choosing the lowest price.

Could you tell me your usual sleeping position, whether you sleep alone or as a couple, your approximate build, and the size you need? I’ll then guide you towards the most suitable option.

Is there a warranty or guarantee if something goes wrong?

If the defect is confirmed, Tediber may repair or replace the defective product or part, with delivery covered. The warranty does not provide a refund. It excludes normal wear, normal loss of firmness, comfort preferences, misuse, unauthorised modifications, use on an electric bed base, and mattresses not unpacked within 30 days of delivery.

You also have 100 nights to try the mattress at home, with free returns if it does not suit you. This trial is separate from the 10-year warranty.

turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
For the Matelas Hybride Premium ordered on its own, delivery is usually around 24 to 48 hours in Metropolitan France, subject to stock availability. Standard doorstep delivery is free.

If you add old-mattress collection, delivery in France is generally 8 to 10 days. For deliveries elsewhere in Europe, allow around 72 hours with standard delivery.

The available dates for your address will be shown at checkout. Send me your delivery country and mattress size if you’d like the closest estimate.
